title: SmartLedger overview
description: Start page: is each service up, is it inside its SLO, and where to click next. Detailed metrics live in the linked dashboards and consoles.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Last synthetic check per service, from all probes. DOWN when any probe failed.

panels.title: Availability, last 28 days (SLO 99.5%)
panels.description: Successful synthetic checks / all checks. Red below the 99.5% SLO.

targets.expr: sum by (env, job) (increase(probe_all_success_sum[28d])) / sum by (env, job) (increase(probe_all_success_count[28d]))

panels.title: Response time from probes
panels.description: Synthetic request duration, Asia probes. Includes network from Singapore/Tokyo, so it is an upper bound for users in Vietnam.

panels.title: Consoles
panels.description: Links open the provider console; pick the SmartLedger project there. Replace a link with the project's own URL to land on it directly.

options.content:
| Area | Question it answers | Open |
|---|---|---|
| **Core** (Java API) | Deploys, logs, CPU and RAM of the container | [Railway](https://railway.com/dashboard) |
| **AI** (Agent) | Slow or failed chats, model calls, tokens, tools | [Logfire](https://logfire.pydantic.dev/) |
| **Database** | Slow queries, connections, CPU, disk; DAU query | [Supabase](https://supabase.com/dashboard/projects) |
| **Web** | Deploys, build and function logs | [Vercel](https://vercel.com/dashboard) |
| **Auth** | Sign-ins, users, quota | [Firebase](https://console.firebase.google.com/) |
| **Mobile** | Builds and updates | [Expo](https://expo.dev/) |
| **Load tests** | Users, req/s, p95, failures per run | [Dashboard](/d/smartledger-load) · [Run one](https://github.com/miphu2804/smart-ledger/actions/workflows/load-test.yml) |
| **Uptime** | Which check failed and from where | [Checks](/a/grafana-synthetic-monitoring-app/checks) · [Scheduled probe](https://github.com/miphu2804/smart-ledger/actions/workflows/synthetic-monitor.yml) |
| **Releases** | What was deployed and whether CI passed | [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/miphu2804/smart-ledger/actions) |

Not in Grafana yet: Core latency and 5xx (issue #269), Supabase metrics, Redis (deferred).
